content.value_statement: Distributed vector search needs careful replication, metrics, monitoring, and deployment planning. This skill gives a phased AgentDB workflow for scalable hybrid search systems.
actual_capabilities: Guides a five-phase AgentDB rollout from setup through production operations.
Shows how to configure primary and replica databases with QUIC synchronization.
Explains custom distance metrics, hybrid scoring, and domain-specific similarity.
Covers HNSW indexing, caching, quantization, and benchmark planning.
Includes monitoring, alerting, health checks, and runbook structure.
limitations: Requires existing TypeScript, Node.js, vector database, and distributed systems knowledge.
Assumes AgentDB packages and deployment targets are available and trusted.
Provides implementation guidance, not managed hosting or live infrastructure.
Production examples require review for each organization security policy.

use_cases.title: Plan Distributed Search Infrastructure
use_cases.description: Design a primary and replica AgentDB cluster with synchronization, health checks, and failover planning.

use_cases.title: Improve Similarity Quality
use_cases.description: Create custom distance metrics and hybrid search strategies for specialized embedding workloads.

use_cases.title: Prepare Production Operations
use_cases.description: Define monitoring, alerting, backup, runbook, and validation steps for an AgentDB deployment.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Basic Setup
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to create a beginner setup plan for AgentDB advanced vector search. Include prerequisites, phases, and validation checks.

prompt_templates.title: Configure Replication
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to design primary and replica AgentDB configuration with QUIC synchronization, routing, failover, and health monitoring.

prompt_templates.title: Benchmark Hybrid Search
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to compare custom distance metrics, hybrid scoring, HNSW indexing, caching, and quantization for my workload.

prompt_templates.title: Design Production Operations
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to build a production AgentDB rollout plan with observability, alerting, backup, runbook steps, and readiness checks.

output_examples.input: Build a high availability AgentDB search cluster.
output: A five-phase rollout covering setup, primary configuration, replicas, QUIC sync, monitoring, and validation.
A checklist for synchronization lag, failover, health endpoints, and production readiness.

output_examples.input: Improve vector search quality for domain data.
output: A metric plan comparing cosine, weighted Euclidean, hybrid similarity, and domain-specific scoring.
A benchmark outline with latency, recall, precision, and memory targets.
A monitoring plan for search latency, insert throughput, replication lag, cache hit rate, and memory usage.
An operations runbook for deployment, smoke tests, troubleshooting, backup, and traffic ramp.

best_practices: Review every package, command, and deployment target before running generated setup steps.
Keep secrets in approved environment or secret management systems, never in source files.
Validate replication, latency, accuracy, backup, and rollback behavior before production traffic.
anti_patterns: Do not copy production examples without adapting network names, credentials, and security controls.
Do not optimize HNSW, cache, or quantization settings without workload benchmarks.
Do not enable alerting integrations until recipients, keys, and escalation rules are verified.

faq.question: Does this skill run commands automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides commands and code examples for review before an engineer or assistant runs them.

faq.question: Which assistants can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code as supported tools.

faq.question: What knowledge is required?
faq.answer: Users should understand TypeScript, Node.js, vector databases, embeddings, and distributed system operations.

faq.question: Can it design custom similarity metrics?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers weighted, hybrid, and domain-specific metrics with benchmark and validation guidance.

faq.question: Does it manage secrets?
faq.answer: No. It uses environment variable placeholders and expects secure secret management outside the skill.

faq.question: Is this a complete production platform?
faq.answer: No. It is implementation guidance for teams that operate their own AgentDB infrastructure.
